mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hyponatremia which can potentiate neuromuscular blockade and increase seizure risk; piperacillin-tazobactam is renally cleared and may accumulate with thiazide-induced renal function changes.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly during concurrent use; assess renal function and adjust piperacillin-tazobactam dosing if needed; consider potassium supplementation if hypokalemia develops.
